summary: Frontend-only Playwright validation of the new 5-tab Super App shell. Logged in as player@vitquest.com/player123 and exercised every acceptance criterion in the review request. All 11 requested behaviors PASS end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout uses `hidden` attribute — this correctly preserves child state (map zoom/route, chat draft, sync progress) across tab switches. Verified: route polyline count unchanged (21 -> 21) after Navigate -> Squad -> Navigate.

CampusHubPage class-alert uses a 5s interval + minsUntil window (14.5 < x <= 15) with alertFiredRef guard. Works, but if user backgrounds the tab or the setTimeout is throttled, the 30s window (15 -> 14.5 min) could be missed on slow devices. Consider firing on any minsUntil <= 15 when alertFiredRef is false.

Banned-word check uses toLowerCase + includes on the whole string — good; matches 'this is spam', 'SPAM', substring 'spammer' too. If false positives are a concern later, switch to word-boundary regex.
Opportunities filter matches p.skills.includes(filter) OR p.tag === filter. 'Competitions' filter matches skill tag correctly (Kaggle, AdVITya, SIH). Verified Python narrows 5 -> 3.

ProfileMerged embeds real <Profile/> + stats row + real <Leaderboard/>. The Leaderboard heading text is 'Global Leaders' not literally 'Leaderboard' — worth noting but the component itself and current-user highlight (#8 Player One YOU) render correctly.
All new interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full acceptance matrix verified: (1) bottom-nav has exactly 5 testids nav-navigate/nav-squad/nav-hub/nav-opportunities/nav-profile. (2) Default tab is Campus Hub with schedule-card containing OS Lab / AB-1 · Room 304 / Prof. Menon and sync-vtop button; Dashboard content (welcome, LevelRing L3/670XP, streak/quests/badges stats, Active Quests: AB-1 Lecture Marathon, AB-3 Corridor Recon, Library Whispers, Admin Block Errand, Plaza Sunrise, Mess Master Chef) is preserved below. (3) sync-vtop shows 'Syncing VTOP…' spinner for ~2s then 'VTOP Schedule Synced Successfully' toast. (4) class-alert-modal appears within ~15s of entering Campus Hub; alert-dismiss closes it. (5) Squad has friend-dev/aron/lakshay each with locate-* and chat-*. (6) chat-modal opens with 3 pre-seeded bubbles; 'this is spam' is blocked with red toast 'Message blocked: Contains inappropriate language.' and no bubble appended. (7) 'meet at 7' appends a 4th (blue, right-aligned) bubble. (8) Opportunities has filter-All/Python/React/ML/Competitions; Python narrows 5->3 cards; apply-* fires 'Applied to …' toast. (9) Navigate tab renders 61 SVG elements with buildings AB-1, Mayuri, Cricket, etc. (10) Profile tab shows Profile (avatar/badges/gallery/community) + stats row (1250 XP, Lv 5, 14 Day Streak) + Global Leaders leaderboard with '#8 Player One YOU' highlight. (11) State preservation: opened Cricket → Directions on Navigate (polyline count 21) → switched to Squad → back to Navigate → polyline count still 21 (route preserved). All acceptance criteria satisfied — no changes required.
